title: Apps Running End To End After Restructure
description: After the heavy monorepo restructure, get all apps running end to end. Immediate failure: bun run dev:procedural:3d / compose-desktop cannot find electron because electron-forge only looks for npm/yarn/pnpm lockfiles, not bun.lock, under hoisted bun workspaces. Fix root causes and smoke-run the main app entrypoints.
summary: Duplicate of open ticket 26/08/06/APPS-RUNNING-END-TO-END. Continuing on the existing ticket.
